notes: Total 60 as published; section headers (Objective-1, Locations-10, Weapons-3, Blue-7, Red-21, Characters-18) are counts, not cards.

Posted 'BHBM' dested Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place; 'Throne Room' Death Star II: Throne Room; 'DS 2 docking bay' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'Cloud City docking bay' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Endor docking bay' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'Caridia' Carida.

Posted 'Cloud City Plaza' dested Cloud City: Downtown Plaza (the Dark Special Edition site; Cloud City: Upper Plaza Corridor is the other Dark 'Plaza' site). Posted 'Hoth war room x2' dested the Dark Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room), 2 copies as posted.

Posted 'Zuckuss in ship' / 'Bossk in ship' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter / Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Vader's saber' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Mara's saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.

Posted 'DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Tarkin' Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Doctor E' Dr. Evazan; 'Emperor' Emperor Palpatine; 'Janus' Janus Greejatus; 'Ozzel' Admiral Ozzel; 'Evax' Officer Evax; 'Cabbel' Lieutenant Cabbel; 'Twi'lek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'IAO' Imperial Arrest Order; 'Force lighting' Force Lightning.
Posted 'IG-88' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun: the strategy calls this card 'ig-88 with gun'.
The 11/11/00 update suggests swaps (Senses/Alters for Controls, IG-88 and Captain Godherdt for ships); not applied to the list.

Sokol played Bring Him Before Me ("the beast") as his Dark deck on Days 1-2 of the 2000 Decipher World Championship (Day 2 8th; he switched to ISB Operations for Day 3 and won the event); the Deck Designs pages cover only his ISB Operations / Hidden Base lists.
player_note: The post's description says: "this was my choice deck for day 1,2 and the team tourney at DecipherCon." (posted 13 October 2000; strategy updated 11 November 2000, saying "my new version of the deck recks house", so the posted list may differ from what was played).
